pictures.author: DGtal
pictures.observed: Inspected960×720 night overview:large rectangular buff-stone enclosure,regular upper shallow pilasters,rounded crenellations,substantial square corner minarets with projecting balcony stages and small dark caps. One taller plain inner roof mass rises behind the enclosure. Night lighting and temporary flags/fixtures are not model surface colors. Ground landscaping and modern furniture remain host content.

pictures.author: Zairon
pictures.observed: Inspected960×710 daylight front approach:large pale/buff ashlar lower wall,closely spaced shallow upper pilasters under a continuous coping and rounded merlon sequence. Two square stone minarets have narrow paired lights,projecting corbelled gallery stages,dark open upper pavilions and little pitched/faceted caps. Broad low approach stair in foreground. Exact heights,stair/platform levels and finer coping dimensions remain estimates.

pictures.author: Zairon
pictures.observed: Inspected960×544 nearer enclosure corner:massive pale tan stone courses,upper pilaster strips and thin horizontal cornice,rounded parapet teeth. Small attached lower range with a dark little dome at one end,plain taller inner wall behind opposite corner,arched side opening at right. Fine stone deterioration,vegetation,cables,signs and unseen roof arrangement omitted or unverified.
